onb.welcome.title: Welcome to Perene
onb.welcome.body: A home for your AI coding agents. Run Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and plain shells side by side — organized, persistent, and out of your way.
onb.welcome.tip: This tour takes about a minute. You can reopen it anytime in Settings.
onb.sessions.title: Your sessions don't die
onb.sessions.body: A background service owns every terminal. Close the window — even quit the app — and your agents keep running. Reopen and you're back where you left off, scrollback and all.
onb.sessions.tip: After a reboot, panes come back and the CLIs resume the same conversation.
onb.profiles.title: Start a session
onb.profiles.body: Pick a tool in the bottom bar. Each one launches in a login shell, so your PATH, aliases and profile are exactly like your terminal.
onb.profiles.tip: In a git repo, Perene offers to run the session in an isolated worktree — the agent works on its own branch without touching your tree.
onb.organize.title: Organize your work
onb.organize.body: Workspaces hold folders, folders hold tabs. Drag tabs between folders to keep related sessions together.
onb.organize.tip: Right-click anything here for the full menu: new session, rename, set directory, move, delete.
onb.editor.title: Editor and git, built in
onb.editor.body: Open the editor to browse files, edit with syntax highlighting, review side-by-side diffs, commit and push — without leaving the app.
onb.editor.tip: The title bar always shows the branch of the active pane, with fetch, pull, push and pull requests one click away.
onb.shortcuts.title: Move fast
onb.shortcuts.body: The shortcuts you already know from your editor work here too.
onb.shortcuts.tip: Set your language, shell and font size in Settings (⌘,).
onb.splits.title: Split your view
onb.splits.body: Split any pane to the right or below, or apply a layout preset — columns, rows or a grid. Watch an agent work while you type in another.
onb.splits.tip: Drag the divider between panes to resize; the proportion is remembered.
onb.git.title: Git is always in sight
onb.git.body: The current branch of the active pane lives up here, with dirty state and ahead/behind counts. Click it to switch or create a branch, fetch, pull, push or open a pull request.
onb.git.tip: It follows the active pane — so a session running in a worktree shows that worktree's branch.
